name: Menacing
body:
Menacing
Source Ultimate Intrigue pg. 40
If the ranger selects menacing, he can choose from the following list whenever he gains a combat style feat: Dazzling Display, Enforcer, Gory Finish, and Intimidating Prowess. At 6th level, he adds Martial Dominance and Shatter Defenses to the list. At 10th level, he adds Dreadful Carnage and Improved Critical to the list.
